k243031831.notes: Landsbankinn bank sign (logo box plus white lettering on a dark-blue bar) high on a building, Reykjavík, rainy street view. Distractors: 'American Style' restaurant fascia and flags below, GINGER van.

k243043145.notes: Dim, dusky shot: temporary white direction sign with HARPA and a left arrow (smaller second line, probably 'CONCERT HALL', unreadable) next to a 30 limit sign on a construction fence, Reykjavík. Gold letters on the building (TOLLHÚSIÐ) are too dark to read reliably. 'ÞG VERK / Síðan 1998' construction banner is a distractor.

p0782d21b12.notes: Cut-out metal letters on a black plate over a shop, Reykjavík, on a black-and-white mural wall. 'caratoes' (mural artist signature) and window reflections are distractors.

p4129b7796f.notes: Widely spaced dark serif letters painted on a white facade, Reykjavík (rainbow street). A lamppost passes over the Ð, so its crossbar is hidden; the rest (Ó, Ö, Í) is clearly visible.

p7bebebafdb.notes: Black stencil letters painted on an ochre wall among doodle figures, Reykjavík. Distractors: 66°NORTH sign and Geiri Smart awning on the left, 'BAD TASTE RECORD SHOP' door stickers, smaller repeated SMEKKLEYSA logos.

p7f794fd5fd.notes: Red 'Cafe' script and yellow oval 'Babalú' sign on an orange house, Reykjavík; 'ROOF TOP DINING' board above. The mural wall to the right lists menu items (crêpes, paninis, drinks...) and is a distractor.

padf57f478c.reason: private-parking notice (EINKABÍLASTÆÐI / PRIVATE PARKING), motion-blurred; not a place name

pc11bcf4b2a.notes: Dark hanging board with light lowercase 'kokka' under an awning, Laugavegur, Reykjavík (dusk). Second hanging sign 'kroll' further along is a distractor.

pc723340085.notes: White Reykjavík street plate with black letters on a lamppost, against the sky; note the æ ligature.

pdc571acde4.notes: Yellow, red-bordered hanging sign of the Björk tobacco shop, Reykjavík, with a Sherlock Holmes silhouette; styled as a warning sign ('Varúð!' = caution). A reflection of the sign in the window is a distractor.

c114807167.notes: Arched red-and-green painted fascia over the door of Prikið café, Bankastræti 12, Reykjavík; '12' (house number) appears in the right corner and is cut off at top left. Side panels repeat 'PRIKIÐ / STOFNAÐ 1951 / NÝLAGAÐ GÆÐAKAFFI / FRÁ MORGNI TIL KVÖLDS / BRAUÐ OG KÖKUR'; LAVAZZA panels and the menu board are distractors.

c119366716.reason: runway landscape at Reykjavík Airport; only a tiny jet-blast warning sign

c119366717.reason: 'VARÚÐ! / CAUTION! JET BLAST HAZARD' warning sign; no place name

c140431348.reason: church tower and mountain in Siglufjörður; no sign

c16024763.reason: hiking-trail legend panel with paragraphs of Icelandic text; no single place-name target

c24848170.reason: picnic-area pictogram sign only; no text

c33779855.notes: Yellow hanging shop sign with blue text for the 12 Tónar record shop, Skólavörðustígur 15, Reykjavík. The right half of the photo is its mirror reflection in the shop window (reversed text, distractor). Small photographer credit text at the bottom right edge.

c37262834.notes: Cut-out museum name board hanging in an arched window, backlit, photographed in Húsavík (the museum has since moved to Reykjavík). The small logo at the top repeats 'HIÐ ÍSLENZKA REÐASAFN' over an outline map of Iceland.
